steps.text: Pip needs glowy things for new lanterns. Find the glow shells round the lake. They shine brightest at night!
checklist: A glow shell by the southwest shore
A glow shell by the south shore
A glow shell by the dock
A glow shell by the west shore
A glow shell by the north boardwalk

steps.text: Bring the glow shells to Pip, who's out looking at lamps in the evening.

reward.message: Pip's moon-lamps are up along the boardwalks! Go and see them glow after dark.
